## 席位核对

- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36368` CLEAN(13 项无标记);draft、base `main`、`Fixes #35611`,卡上要做的就是裁决记录 7075362923 第 1、2 项,本 PR 全部交付,所以 `Fixes` 正确;第 3 项(#35495 重新合入)按裁决归 #35079 那条车道,本 PR 正文写明不做。2 个文件 +137 −12;改的是 `scripts/pm/**`,不发布任何包,`skip-changeset` 正确;`Clause-②: no`;`Ruling-ref: 7075362923` 在正文里。
- 裁决对账:裁决 B 第 1 项是「测试与仓库脚本照旧判红,发布包源码只报告」,对应 `mkdtempCompleteness` 把 site 分成 `failing` 和 `reported`,live 用例只在 `failing` 非空时判红,`reported` 逐条写在同一行里,不会静默。第 2 项是「按文件分,不按在不在仓内,也不能只用 `isTestFilePath`」,对应 `isShippedPackageSource`:复用 runner-env 门禁的 `isRunnerEnvProductSource`,它比只看文件名的 `isTestFilePath` 更严,`src/__tests__/` 下的辅助文件照样判红;再加工作区包的 `src/` 前缀,不另维护一份清单。`exposedScratchDirs`(在仓内但没被覆盖的规则)一字未动;没有新门禁、派生行、ratchet 或常量。
- 收窄幅度:我的 grep 和 dev 用扫描自己的导出取的读数一致:今天 1821 个 `mkdtempSync` site 里,发布包源码有 14 个,全在系统临时目录;任何一类里都没有 unresolved。所以落地当下没有任何 site 由判红变成只报告,收窄只作用于将来,比如 #35495 那一处。dev 在 scratch worktree 里实测过:套上 #35495 的 diff 后,main 上的规则判红,本分支的规则 failing 0、reported 1,exposed 0。
- 测试证据:fast tier 新增 10 条钉,用的正是当初让 main 变红的那个写法。每一臂旁边都有一步之差的对照:同一文件换到非工作区包、出了 `src/`、换成测试文件或工具脚本,都翻回判红;base 改成 `tmpdir()` 就两边都不进。在本 head 上 `dispatch-gates --self-test` 两个 tier 共 2577 条全过,`pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` exit 0;`--ran` 63 族,62 跑、1 NOT MEASURED(`check:i18n-coverage`,前置未满足,本 diff 不碰任何包,CI 覆盖)。
- 门禁 check-runs @ `f7e942e8`:27 success · 26 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending;Lint & Repo Gates、TypeScript Type Check 均 success。
- 消融:没跑。派发契约不要求对仓库脚本做消融;每条钉都自带对照,而且对照真的会翻转结论,这里接受。
- dev 问的边界(`private: true` 的工作区成员算不算发布源码):本 head 照席位 rider 的字面读法实现,算。我的读法:保持现状,不改。理由:① `private` 不能代表「不由用户运行」。比如 `apps/docs` 是 private,但它以站点形式部署运行;`examples/*` 也会被用户当模板复制出去。按 manifest 的 private 来切,并不比按 `src/` 切更贴近「扫描只管仓内运行的代码」。② 今天 private 成员的 `src/` 里一个 `mkdtempSync` 都没有,两种读法结论相同。③ 将来真出现这样的 site,它会写在 live 用例那一行的 reported 里,不会静默。如果维护者认为 private 成员要照样判红,只需改一个子句,另开 PR 即可。请席位在 Tier H 速读里把这一句列给维护者看。
- 范围外去向:无(#35495 重新合入按裁决由 #35079 的车道做)。
- 落地条款:Tier H(`dispatch-gates.mjs` 是守卫仪器)。L1 ACCEPT 在此;席位契约档 L2(claim 7076571217)PASS 后,由席位做终局四件套,挂 `pm:awaiting-merge` 并请维护者审批。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f7e942e8e230378971c7bb4816cec14aa0dfefec`
Local-runs: none
Scope: scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs + scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs

Inputs read: card 35611 with all 7 comments (ruling record 7075362923, decision request 7070807556, triage 7016891982, os-dev-report 7076404532), PR 36368 body and its one comment, the net diff against merge base `d8599c2c` (2 files, +137 / -12), and the check-runs on this head. The cited code was read in the head tree: `scripts/check-runner-env-posture.mjs` (`isProductSource`, `isTestFile`), `scripts/workspace-enumerator.mjs` (`workspacePackageDirs`, `workspacePackages`), `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, the member manifests, `instrument-discipline.md`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set of the completeness rule. Before: every UNRESOLVED `mkdtempSync` site fails. After: it fails unless `isShippedPackageSource(file, packageDirs)`, i.e. `isProductSource(file)` and the file sits under `MEMBER/src/` for a workspace member holding a manifest. Right for published packages (binding item 1). Wrong for members that are never published: see M1.
- Binding item 2 (file population, never "in-tree", never `isTestFilePath` alone): right. The predicate reads the site's file only; tooling (`scripts/**`, package `scripts/`, package `test/` helpers, `.cjs`, anything outside a member's own `src/`) stays failing; `src/__tests__/`, `fixtures/`, `.e2e.`, `.pin.`, `.bench.` stay failing through `isTestFile`, which is stricter than `isTestFilePath`.
- Binding item 3 (the 35495 re-land): not in this diff, correctly left to card 35079's lane.
- Riders: the 30467 site (`packages/cloud-connection/src/local-manifest-source.ts`) is untouched; spellings 7 and 8 are untouched (`SCRATCH_CALL` and the `mkdirSync` half are not in the diff).
- `exposedScratchDirs` (the in-tree / uncovered rule) is unchanged for every population: right. No new gate, derivation row, ratchet, tier or constant; two exported functions, the one boundary predicate the decision request priced. Inside `instrument-discipline.md` as narrowed by the ruling.
- Public surface: two new exports of a repo script, consumed by its own self-test only. Nothing published.
- Gate verdicts on this head: all check-runs completed, each success or skipped (Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo and tooling gates, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check Changeset, Type Check families, Test Core: success). NOT MEASURED by any check-run: the slow-tier live case ("no mkdtempSync site in a test file or repo tooling…"); PR CI runs the fast tier only, so its green on this head is the dev's reported run, and the scheduled full run on `main` is its first CI measurement.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: `scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing and no package file is in the diff. `Clause-②: no` matches (no published contract moves). `Ruling-ref: 7075362923` is on the PR body, as the ruling record's Workload line asks.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev open question (do private workspace members count as shipped): answered, reading B, and graded M1 below. The ruling's binding text supports excluding them; the rider's literal wording does not outrank it.
- Dev deviation "no Ruling-ref line": moot, the body at this head carries the line.
- Dev deviations on run handling (one foreground run, two stopped detached runs, the pre-PR merge of `main`, model-free trailers): no contract effect.
- The dev's claim "0 `mkdtempSync` sites in a private member's `src/`" holds on the head tree by reading: the 14 call spellings under a member `src/` that are not tests are in `packages/cli` (2), `packages/drivers/driver-turso` (1) and `packages/qa/scenarios` (11), all three published manifests.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no data access in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`

M1 (must-fix) — the predicate narrows the guard past the ruling for workspace members that are never published. The maintainer's verbatim choice is 「扫描只管仓内运行的代码」 and the option's consequence is 「完整性规则只管测试与仓库脚本,发布代码同类调用只报告不判红」; binding item 1 keeps repo tooling failing. A `private: true` member is not 发布代码 and is exactly 仓内运行的代码: at this head that is `packages/eslint-plugin`, `packages/qa/dogfood`, `packages/qa/downstream-contract`, `packages/qa/http-conformance`, `packages/qa/refd-timer-testkit`, `packages/qa/vitest-filter-preflight`, `examples/*`, `apps/docs`, `packages/apps/connector-*`, and under `ui/` the root, `packages/app-shell`, `packages/runner`, `packages/test-support`, `examples/*`. Several of these are repo tooling or test harness in package form. `isShippedPackageSource` reports an unresolved site in their `src/` instead of failing it. The code's own stated reason does not reach them either: the header and the jsdoc both justify the exemption by "whoever runs the published code" / "a published command stages beside a directory its USER names", and a private member has no such user. The rider that reads "a workspace package's `src/`" is recorded as the seat's reading at the request's defaults, "not the maintainer's words"; it defines the term "shipped", was measured on 13 sites that are all in published packages, and cannot widen binding item 1. Zero verdicts differ today (0 sites), which is why this is cheap to close now and why it must not wait: the instrument is frozen and a later card has no derivation-distortion licence to reopen it. Fix: one clause, members whose manifest is not `private: true` (the enumerator's `workspacePackages` already pairs each member with its manifest, so no list is kept here); a fast pin for a private member's `src/` that FAILS, with the published arm as its control; the header and jsdoc sentence aligned. Alternative close without a code change: the maintainer's own recorded words ratifying the literal rider for private members.

Otherwise the hunk holds against the code it cites. `isRunnerEnvProductSource` is `isProductSource` of `check-runner-env-posture.mjs` (source extension, a `src/` segment, not `.d.ts`, not `isTestFile`), as the jsdoc says. `workspacePackageDirs(ROOT)` returns sorted repo-relative POSIX member directories holding a manifest and throws on an unreadable workspace file rather than returning an empty list, so the default cannot silently turn every site into `failing: 0`; an empty list would send every site to `failing`, the safe side. The `${dir}/src/` prefix with its slashes cannot match a sibling such as `packages/cli-x/`. `mkdtempCompleteness` drops only `mkdirSync`, as before. Attempts to break it that did not land: a template manifest under `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/` (not a member; its files sit under the package's own `src/` and are published); `.cjs` and `.cts` (held, or shipped only under `src/`); a declaration file (no sites by `DECLARATION_FILE`).

Header measurement: plausible by reading. The call spelling counted on the head tree gives 1844 raw occurrences (1466 in `isTestFilePath` files, 14 under a member `src/` that are not tests) against the header's 1821 / 1463 / 14 taken through the scan, which also masks comments and string fixtures; the shipped figure matches exactly. The "47 in the tree" and "0 unresolved" figures were not re-measured here.

- nit N1 — the header's "344 in repo tooling and the other non-package sources" misnames the bucket: it also holds package files (18 under `packages/spec/scripts`, package `test/` helpers, by-directory tests that `isTestFilePath` does not match). "every other source" would be accurate.
- nit N2 — the measurement is dated to `80421551`, a branch commit that a squash merge leaves unreachable from `main`; the base `3f7fdd00` beside it is the durable anchor.
- nit N3 — "reported" is a suffix on a passing line of the slow tier only. That meets the ruling's letter; nothing else reads it.

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`

The live case calls the same `mkdtempCompleteness` the pins call, fails on `failing` alone and names `reported` sites on its line: agrees with the rule. The ten pins: the shipped arm, the not-a-member control, the by-name and by-directory test arms, the tooling arm (with `!isTestFilePath`, which pins binding item 2), both tmpdir controls, the `mkdirSync` arm (asserting the site really is unresolved) and the default-workspace arm each discriminate what they name.

S1 (should-fix) — the control "in the package but outside its own src/ (one directory up)" does not isolate the clause it names. Its path `packages/cli/utils/skills-install-state.ts` has no `src/` segment at all, so `isProductSource` already answers false; replacing `${dir}/src/` with `${dir}/` in the predicate leaves all ten pins green. The member's-own-`src/` half is therefore unpinned (live population today: 0 files under `packages`, `apps`, `examples`). A path such as `packages/cli/scripts/src/staging.ts` (product source by name, under the member, not under its own `src/`) expecting FAIL closes it. Non-blocking on its own and could be carried on a follow-up card, since this file is not the frozen instrument; as M1 moves the head anyway, it rides best in the same commit.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `3ec2a452021883bd855adc1ffd83aee5c000e265`
Local-runs: none
Scope: scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs + scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs

Delta review of the record on `f7e942e8` (comment 7076625985, FAIL). Read this round: the one rework commit `3ec2a452` as a diff against `f7e942e8` and the net diff against merge base `d8599c2c` (2 files, +174 / -13); the card's new os-dev-report 7077315476; the PR body as patched and its comments (L1 ACCEPT 7076590966 with its correction 7076609986, delta claim 7077344610); the check-runs on this head; `workspacePackages` in `scripts/workspace-enumerator.mjs` and `packages/qa/dogfood/package.json` in the head tree.

M1: closed
S1: closed
N1: closed
N2: closed

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set of the completeness rule at this head: an UNRESOLVED `mkdtempSync` site fails unless its file is `isProductSource` and sits under the own `src/` of a workspace member whose parsed manifest is not `private: true`. That is binding item 1 of ruling record 7075362923 read against the maintainer's words: published code is reported; tests, repo tooling and every never-published member (examples, the docs app, QA harnesses, the eslint plugin) stay failing. Right.
- The rework only moves sites from `reported` to `failing`. Nothing is narrowed relative to `f7e942e8`, and against `main` the narrowing is now the published-member population alone: the 14 sites, all in `packages/cli`, `packages/drivers/driver-turso` and `packages/qa/scenarios`.
- A member whose manifest does not parse is absent from `workspacePackages` and therefore held; an empty member list holds every site. Both fall on the failing side. Right.
- Binding items 2 and 3 and the riders are as judged on `f7e942e8`; the rework touches none of them. `exposedScratchDirs` unchanged. No new gate, derivation row, ratchet, tier or constant; one more name taken from an import line that already existed.
- Gate verdicts on this head: every check-run completed, each success or skipped (Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo and tooling gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Type Check families, Test Core: success). NOT MEASURED by a check-run, as before: the slow-tier live case; its green on this head is the dev's reported run.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `skip-changeset` is right (`scripts/pm/**` publishes nothing), `Clause-②: no` matches, `Ruling-ref: 7075362923` is on the body.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The private-member question is answered in the tree as reading B; the rework report carries no open question.
- Dev deviation (PR body left to the seat): the seat patched it; see N4.
- SQL push-down: not applicable.

### ④ Design judgment

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`

- M1. `isShippedPackageSource(rel, members)` now takes the enumerator's `{ dir, manifest }` pairs and requires `manifest?.private !== true` beside the `MEMBER/src/` prefix; `mkdtempCompleteness` defaults to `workspacePackages(ROOT)`. No list is kept here. The header sentence and the jsdoc now say "a workspace member whose manifest is not `private: true`" and give the reason the exemption stops at private members (no outside user). Code and prose agree sentence by sentence.
- Tried to break it: nested members (`ui` beside `ui/packages/*`) cannot lend a published prefix to a private member's file, since the prefix carries `/src/`; `workspacePackageDirs` is still imported for its other caller, so no dead import; the old `packageDirs` option name has no remaining reader in either file.
- N1. The bucket now reads "every other source outside shipped package source (repo tooling, package scripts, test helpers and tests by directory…)", which is what it holds.
- N2. The measurement is dated to the tree of `d8599c2c`, a `main` commit, and re-read there: 1823 / 1465 / 344 / 14, 0 unresolved, with "0 under a private member's `src/`" added. The shipped figure matches the count by reading; the others were not re-measured here.

`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`

- S1. The new control `packages/cli/scripts/src/staging.ts` expects FAIL and asserts in the same case that the path is `isProductSource`, so it stands on the member's-own-`src/` clause alone: loosening `MEMBER/src/` to `MEMBER/` turns it to reported and the pin red.
- M1 pin. The same path with `private: true` on the member FAILS, its control being the published arm (identical path, flag absent). The live-workspace arm adds `packages/qa/dogfood/src/staging.ts` expecting FAIL and asserts from the manifest on disk that the member really is private, so the arm cannot go vacuous if that package is ever published.
- The other pins were re-shaped to the pair form without changing what they discriminate. Every name the new lines use (`runnerEnvIsProductSource`, `readFileSync`, `nodePath`, `ROOT`) is already imported.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- nit N3 (carried) — "reported" remains a suffix on a passing slow-tier line; meets the ruling's letter.
- nit N4 — the PR body, outside the reviewed files: the seat's patch landed mid-sentence in Acceptance notes, cutting the 35495 result ("…Result: origin/ma") and leaving the tail of the old open-question bullet after it; "What changes" and the Tests table still name the `packageDirs` option, and the quoted runs are the pre-rework ones (2262 / 2577 cases against 2264 / 2579 now). A prose fix on the body, no head move; worth doing before the maintainer reads it for Tier H.
- nit N5 — `private` is read as the boolean `true` only; a manifest spelling it as a string would count as published. No such manifest in the tree.

L1 ACCEPT(增量)· head `3ec2a452021883bd855adc1ffd83aee5c000e265` · 2026-11-22T10:04Z

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:没有产品变化。这是派发门禁 `dispatch-gates` 里 `mkdtempSync` 完整性规则的边界:已发布包的 `src/` 里查不清临时目录位置的调用,只报告、不判红;仓库脚本、测试,以及**不发布的私有工作区成员**(示例应用、QA 测试架子、文档站)的 `src/`,仍然判红。
- 为什么做:卡 #35611,按你的裁决 7075362923「扫描只管仓内运行的代码」。席位 L2 7076625985 指出,上一版把私有成员也算成了「发布代码」,超出了裁决范围;本轮按 B 读法收回。
- 出错会怎样:只影响门禁判红的范围,不碰产品。当前树上私有成员 `src/` 里没有这类调用,所以今天没有任何判定会变;收回的是将来的漏网口。
- 要你做什么:这是受管 PR(Tier H,门禁仪器),等席位完成最终四件事后,由你批合。
- 席位意见:增量 L1 ACCEPT。我上一轮的 ACCEPT 7076590966 曾把私有成员读成「可报告」,席位推翻了这个读法,本轮的代码按席位的读法落实,我认同。

## 席位核对

- 增量范围:相对上一轮 `f7e942e8`,只有一个提交 `3ec2a452`,只改两个文件:`dispatch-gates.mjs` 和它的 self-test。
- L2 M1(私有成员):已修。`isShippedPackageSource(rel, members)` 现在要求 `manifest?.private !== true`,成员表来自枚举器的 `workspacePackages`,是 `{ dir, manifest }` 对,本文件不另存名单。manifest 解析不了的成员会被 `workspacePackages` 丢掉(workspace-enumerator.mjs:305–314),于是不在成员表里,照样判红,和 jsdoc 写的一致。
- L2 S1(自己的 `src/`):已补一条钉 `packages/cli/scripts/src/staging.ts`,期望判红,并同时断言它按名字算产品源码。这样把前缀从 `MEMBER/src/` 放宽成 `MEMBER/` 时,这条会变红。
- L2 N1、N2:表头把那一桶改称「every other source outside shipped package source」,并列出它包含什么;测量改为按合并基点 `d8599c2c` 的树标日期,不再引用 squash 后会消失的分支提交。
- 我的本地探针:把本 PR 的 `dispatch-gates.mjs` 临时放进主 checkout,直接调用 `mkdtempCompleteness`,结果是 failing/reported:已发布成员 `src/` 为 0/1,同一路径标成 private 为 1/0,`packages/cli/scripts/src/` 为 1/0;用本树真实工作区时,`packages/qa/dogfood/src/`(private)为 1/0,`packages/cli/src/` 为 0/1,`scripts/pm/` 为 1/0。跑完已用 `git checkout HEAD --` 恢复,工作区干净。完整的 self-test 我在本地也跑过一遍,但输出被 tail 截掉,只看得到最后几条通过,所以不作为读数;self-test 以 CI 的 Lint · PM dispatch-gates 为准。
- 形态:`l1-face --pr 36368` CLEAN;门禁 check-runs @ `3ec2a452`:27 success · 25 expected skip · 0 failed · 0 pending;mergeable_state clean。`check-governed-merges`:2 个路径里有 1 个命中受管登记,所以是受管 PR,187 行。
